description: Defines the BaseEventDelegate class which manages event notifications, including registration, dispatching, and emitter management within a notification system.

classes.name: BaseEventDelegate
classes.description: Manages event notification registration, dispatching, and emitter lifecycle for application notifications.

classes.name: EventDelegateDispatchJob
classes.description: Inner class implementing dispatch job for event notification, used to asynchronously invoke notification dispatch.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event with payload if the notification is registered, using a worker pool.

methods.name: DispatchToAppNotifications
methods.description: Sends the event and payload to all registered emitters for the event.

methods.name: AddNotification
methods.description: Registers an emitter for a specific event notification.

methods.name: IsNotificationRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a notification event is registered.

methods.name: GetEmittersForNotification
methods.description: Retrieves all emitters registered for a specific notification event.

methods.name: RemoveNotification
methods.description: Removes an emitter from a notification event, or all events for an emitter if event string is empty.
